title: A finitely presented module flat along a fibre becomes projective over an affine etale neighbourhood
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma globalises the pointwise statement: for a finite presentation morphism and a finitely presented module flat at every point of a fibre, there is an elementary etale neighbourhood of the point of the base and an affine etale neighbourhood of the fibre on which the pulled back module has projective global sections (statement lines 3341-3364, tag 05KW). The proof applies the pointwise proposition at each point of the quasi-compact fibre, passes to finitely many points, chooses one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood, and then takes the disjoint union of the base changed pieces, whose global sections are a direct sum of base changes of projective modules and hence projective by ascent. The assembling step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
